issues.description: Algorithmic complexity is O(n^2): copying the list and re-summing for each candidate causes TLE on large inputs. Use a Counter and count-based checks to achieve O(n).
Unnecessary duplication of work and memory churn: iterates over all elements (including duplicates) and does expensive list operations. Iterate over unique values and use frequency counts instead.
No unit tests provided. Add tests for the examples, duplicates (y == x), negative values, and a large input to validate performance.
Calling max(potential_outliers) without a guard will raise ValueError if the list is empty. The problem guarantees at least one outlier, but a defensive check or comment is recommended.
